queueSourceDesign.principle: Catalogue-driven queue from REAL directories. NEVER synthesize hostnames (gis.{slug}tx.gov returned 0/104).

queueItemShape.cityGeoId: roster geoid when known; empty string forbidden for LAYER-FOUND stage
queueItemShape.seedHostUrls: optional string[] — ONLY URLs previously returned by a directory probe this run or cited in host-catalogue.json with evidenceUrl; never invented

directories.queryTemplate: (title:zoning OR tags:zoning OR typekeywords:Zoning) AND (Texas OR TX) AND ("{cityName}" OR "{cityKey}")
directories.extract: result.url when type in Feature Service|Map Service; also org/group item URLs
CKAN resource URLs that are ArcGIS REST or downloadable GIS; never invent municipal hosts from package names

sources.seedMethod: Hub org/group search + documented open-data portal URLs recorded in host-catalogue.json with evidenceUrl
sources.note: Elgin/Smithville live on services3.arcgis.com/wdTkTU0MdZbNBEZy — catalogue that org from Hub, do not hardcode city→layer

sources.seedMethod: Hub search + H-GAC open data catalogue URLs with evidenceUrl
Hub search + NCTCOG open data catalogue URLs with evidenceUrl

directories.rule: host-catalogue.json entries of kind=county-rest-root must carry evidenceUrl proving the root was observed (Hub item, official open-data page, or prior probe log). Empty/unreachable root → search path HOST-BROKEN for that path only, not city absence.
Portal/base URLs only from Hub results, CKAN, or catalogue evidenceUrl. Recurse ArcGIS REST folders under any discovered root.

hosts.evidenceUrl: string URL or inbox path that observed this host

queueSourceDesign.queueFileParam: --queue=PATH JSON array of queue items (parameterized; no hardcoded cities in runner)

verificationSetPreRegister.why: Z1 dallas FOUND on services.arcgis.com/.../BartonvilleZoning/FeatureServer/0 — distinct source type from Bastrop AGOL pair

verificationSetPreRegister.knownTruthDoNotHintRunner: gis.deerparktx.gov/.../WGS84/Zoning_WGS84/MapServer/0 Code field 301 polys — factory must find via folder recursion from REST root discovered in catalogue/Hub, not via this string in code

verificationSetPreRegister.selectionRule: Pick a city whose LAYER-FOUND layerUrl host is a county-rest-root catalogue entry (not municipal, not services*.arcgis.com). If catalogue+Hub yield none in exit budget, record NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY for candidates and STOP the county-hosted gate as unmet — do not fake with municipal.

verificationSetPreRegister.outOfScopeNote: Constraint shapes need their own payload treatment — record need only; touch nothing in payload contract

verificationSetPreRegister.rule: Positive determination from jurisdictionKind=unincorporated (TX counties generally lack Euclidean zoning authority). Not an empty-search absence.

layerIdentificationSignature.principle: GEOMETRY TYPE + FIELD SHAPE, never name regex. /zon/ matched hurricane evacuation and rail blast zones.

folderRecursion.algorithm: BFS/DFS from ArcGIS REST services root; enqueue folders[]; for each MapServer/FeatureServer fetch ?f=json and inspect layers[]; maxDepth default 4; record every path attempted
folderRecursion.deerParkLesson: Root returns folders including WGS84; zoning is WGS84/Zoning_WGS84 — top-level services:[] is not absence

codeFieldShape.mustHave: at least one field whose sampled distinct values look like district codes (short alphanumeric tokens, cardinality between 2 and 200 inclusive on a sample or returnDistinctValues)

rejectFieldShapes: numeric-only continuous measures without code-like tokens (e.g. LOTSIZE sqft alone)
evac/blast/seed zone vocab when codes match known non-Euclidean patterns WITHOUT a companion district-name field — prefer positive Euclidean evidence

euclideanPositiveSignals: codeField values match common Euclidean token patterns (R-1, SF1, C-2, M1, PUD, etc.) OR
paired description field carries residential/commercial/industrial district language with codeField present
noEuclideanRegimeSignals: Host serves planning constraint layers (min lot size, building lines, historic, conservation) AND
No layer on the same host/service tree passes euclideanPositiveSignals after full folder recursion
Houston: layers 12/13 present with LOTSIZE/BLD__LINE shape → NO-EUCLIDEAN-REGIME, never LAYER-FOUND

scoring.rankCandidates: polygon + codeFieldShape + euclideanPositiveSignals; highest score wins; ties break by featureCount proximity to city bbox overlap
scoring.bboxOverlapRequired: layer extent (reprojected/assumed 4326 when possible) must intersect queue item bbox4326; reject California Pasadena-class extent traps

layerIdentificationSignature.nameRegexForbidden: No /zon/|/zoning/i gate for inclusion or exclusion. Names may appear in close-artifact notes only.

rules.emptySearch: NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY — re-enters queue; never writes absence
rules.noPerCityHardcodeBranches: z1_houston_probe.py:426 is the cautionary corpse — cityKey equality early-returns forbidden

outcomeEnum.hostBrokenNote: HOST-BROKEN is a positive determination about a specific endpoint (landed for that probe generation) but the city may still re-enter when catalogue gains alternate hosts — model as landed with verdict HOST-BROKEN; resume skip applies; method-version bump can force re-queue via --force-city

resumeModel.bom: strip ^\uFEFF on read; write UTF-8 no BOM
resumeModel.skipSet: landed cityKeys ONLY — halted-never-landed MUST re-enter (48457 lesson)

progressShape.haltCleared: optional audit array when operator clears halt

resumeModel.closeArtifactPerRun: {outDir}/run_close.json — per-item typed verdicts + every search path attempted

flags.--engine-path: repo root for spawning stage seam
flags.--stage-apply: when LAYER-FOUND, write staging via H1 seam (neondb); default dry discovery only

stagingThroughH1.onLayerFound: Build ZoningCityRegistryEntry-shaped object in memory from discovery (codeField, layerUrl, cityGeoId from queue/roster). Call normalizeZoningFeature + same INSERT path as stage-tx-zoning-district OR spawn stage CLI with --registry-json overlay file written under outDir — prefer overlay file consumed by discovery-owned stage-from-discovery.mjs that imports normalize from zoning-staging without editing registry.ts/payload-contract/drain.

testsRequiredBeforeMerge: outcome enum exhaustiveness — no boolean found/absent helpers
layer signature rejects LOTSIZE-only and BLD__LINE-only as Euclidean zoning
folder recursion visits nested folders (unit with fixture JSON)
no cityKey=== hardcoded branch (grep gate test)
